why.heading: Why Royal *Softech*
why.intro: What students and families can expect.

items.title: Affiliated programmes
items.text: NEB for +2, and Purbanchal and Tribhuvan Universities for bachelor's degrees.

items.title: Practical learning
items.text: 60 to 80% theory and 20 to 40% practical work, supported by laboratories and, in B.Ed and BBS, an internship from the second year.

items.title: Flexible schedules
items.text: Morning and evening classes, with online evening sessions from 5 pm to 8 pm.

items.title: Scholarships
items.text: Scholarships of 20 to 50% for Dalit students, and scholarship opportunities for Class 11 admissions.

home.headline: Royal Softech College, Lahan
home.summary: Royal Softech College offers NEB +2 and Purbanchal and Tribhuvan University programmes on the East-West Highway in Lahan, Siraha.

programmes.name: +2 Programmes
programmes.summary: Grade 11 and 12 under the National Examinations Board, across Science, Management, Education, Humanities and Law.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degrees
programmes.summary: Bachelor's degrees in business studies, IT education and science, affiliated with Purbanchal University and Tribhuvan University.

admission.intro: Admission follows five steps, from your first enquiry to the start of classes.

steps.title: Enquiry and counselling
steps.body: Visit the college or call the office to discuss which programme suits you.

steps.title: Eligibility
steps.body: +2 requires an SEE result (or equivalent) that meets the programme's requirements. Bachelor's programmes require +2 or an equivalent qualification in a relevant stream.

steps.title: Application
steps.body: Submit the application with academic transcripts, a character certificate, recent photographs and a copy of the citizenship certificate.

steps.title: Selection
steps.body: Applications are reviewed under the rules of the relevant board or university; some programmes include an interview.

steps.title: Enrolment
steps.body: Complete the fee formalities and attend orientation to confirm your subjects and class schedule.

scholarships.intro: Scholarships are available to eligible students.

items.title: Dalit students
items.body: A scholarship of 20 to 50% for Dalit students in BSc, B.Ed and BBS.

items.title: Dr. Kavita Sah Scholarship Scheme
items.body: Scholarship opportunities for students entering Class 11.
